description: The frozen runner's build_run_manifest() function (scripts/run_r13_confirmation.py line 475) incorrectly sets confirmation_executable_sha256 to the value of runtime_config_sha256 instead of computing the actual confirmation executable hash. The actual confirmation executable SHA (41cc60b04f506f63b80c91e036d330d61d79992a86fb975cbe21597bd2d84f57) is only written to confirmation_executable_sha256.txt at the end of the run.
resolution: validate executable identity independently from experiment_source_commit, protocol_sha256, gguf_sha256, runtime_config_sha256, backend_identity, receipt_identity_sha256, and confirmation_executable_sha256.txt (when available at end of run). Do NOT require run_manifest.confirmation_executable_sha256 to equal 41cc60b04f506f63... — that field is known to be defective.
